summary: The name of this bill is "Act to Amend Some Nepal Acts Relating to Women, Children, Gender and Sexual Minorities and Social Security, 2083" (Section 1, Subsection 1, Page 1). The main purpose of this bill is to update the names of the ministry in existing Nepal Acts relating to women, children, gender and sexual minorities and social security in accordance with the Government of Nepal (Allocation of Business) Rules, 2083 (Preamble, Page 1). This bill amends the Social Welfare Act, 2049 to change the name of the ministry (Section 2, Page 1). It amends the National Foundation for Development of Indigenous Nationalities Act, 2058 to update the name of the ministry (Section 3, Page 1). It amends the Senior Citizens Act, 2063 to change the name of the ministry (Section 4, Page 1). It amends the Contribution-based Social Security Act, 2074 to update the name of the ministry in the definition of ministry and committee composition (Section 5). This bill updates the liaison ministry to the Ministry of Women, Children, Gender and Sexual Minorities and Social Security in the National Inclusive Commission Act, 2074 (Section 6), Indigenous Nationalities Commission Act, 2074 (Section 7), Madhesi Commission Act, 2074 (Section 8), National Dalit Commission Act, 2074 (Section 9), Tharu Commission Act, 2074 (Section 10), National Women Commission Act, 2074 (Section 11), and Muslim Commission Act, 2074 (Section 12) (Explanatory Note). It amends the Social Security Act, 2075 to provide that the ministry looking after social security matters, instead of the Ministry of Home Affairs, may formulate guidelines and procedures regarding social security allowance distribution (Section 13). Since this bill only changes the name of the ministry pursuant to the Government of Nepal (Allocation of Business) Rules, 2083, no additional financial liability will fall upon the Government of Nepal (Financial Note). This Act shall come into force immediately upon authentication (Section 1, Subsection 2, Page 1).
title: Act to Amend Some Nepal Acts Relating to Women, Children, Gender and Sexual Minorities and Social Security, 2083
